narration.text: What if you had been shut inside a wooden ship for more than a year, with every animal on earth breathing around you in the dark? What if the water finally began to fall, and still nobody told you when you could walk out?
Eight people. One door, shut by God Himself. And outside, nothing but grey water to every horizon. Stay with me, because the way this story ends will change what waiting means.
